Although Made by Google 2026 event still has eight hours before it officially begins, Google has already fully revealed all details of the Pixel 11, Pixel Watch 5 and Pixel Tag ahead of time.

Here is a summary of everything announced at Made by Google 2026. Each section has a link to our full hands-on article covering the new hardware and software features, with more articles to be published in the coming hours.

Table of Contents

Pixel 11

The Pixel 11 features an all-glass camera module that is 40% thinner than the previous generation, with a significantly reduced protrusion. Google says that when used with the official case, this "step" can almost "completely disappear".

It is equipped with a larger 48-megapixel wide-angle lens with 56% more light intake and a slightly wider field of view. The Tensor G6 processor is paired with a 5x telephoto lens, supporting 30x Super Res Zoom.

The processor comes with 12GB of RAM and 256GB of storage, which is the new base configuration. This year's base model supports 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging (up from 15W on the previous generation), a charging speed increase of up to 25%, while the claimed 30+ hour battery life remains unchanged.

The Pixel 11 is available in four colors: Frost, Obsidian, Hibiscus and Pistachio, starting at US$899.

Hands-on｜Pre-order: Google Store — Amazon — Best Buy

Pixel 11 Pro and 11 Pro XL

The Pro series' bezel-less camera module includes a feature Google calls "HiLight". It replaces the temperature sensor that has been used for three generations, instead appearing as a ring of ambient LED lights around the flash. When the Pixel 11 Pro is placed face down, it indicates various statuses. For example, when Gemini hears your command, different light effects display listening, thinking, and reply states, similar to the Google Home Speaker. You can also set custom color flashes for specific callers (supporting Phone by Google and WhatsApp), with more functions such as message notifications to be added in future updates. You can enable HiLight for individual contacts in Google Contacts and choose from five colors.

  • The Pixel 11 Pro is powered by Google's most powerful Gemini Intelligence, starting at US$1,099 [Hands-on]
  • Pixel 11 Pro's HiLight launches with only two features, with more to be added

The Pixel 11 Pro and 11 Pro XL feature a new 50-megapixel wide-angle lens, along with a 48-megapixel telephoto lens with a larger image sensor and 30% more light intake. This supports 5x portrait mode, and combined with the Tensor G6 and Google's latest imaging model, can achieve 120x Pro Zoom. The processor and redesigned software also make Instant Night Sight up to 4.5 times faster.

The Super Actua display's peak brightness has been increased to 3,600 nits, and features a new coating that doubles scratch resistance.

The Tensor G6 processor comes with 12GB of RAM on the 256GB model. Regarding this 4GB reduction, Google says that thanks to software and chip optimizations, performance is faster and smoother than last year's Pro model. Of course, you can opt for the 512GB or 1TB models to upgrade to 16GB of RAM.

On the 11 Pro XL, wired fast charging reaches about 75% in approximately 30 minutes, and 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging speed has also increased by 29%.

This phone is available in Canyon, Fog, Olive, and the first-ever all-matte Obsidian, inspired by nature. The 6.3-inch Pixel 11 Pro starts at US$1,099, and the 6.8-inch Pixel 11 Pro XL starts at US$1,299. Pro model users now only receive a six-month free trial of AI Pro.

Hands-on｜Pre-order:

Amazon: Pixel 11 Pro｜11 Pro XL

Pixel 11 Pro Fold

The Pixel 11 Pro Fold is nearly 10% lighter than last year's model (239g vs 258g) and is 0.7mm thinner. This foldable phone uses a new fiber glass composite matte back panel that is three times more durable, claimed to be "nearly impossible to destroy by dropping". The redesigned hinge protects the inner screen, reducing damage from accidental drops.

The 6.5-inch outer screen has been upgraded to Super Actua (20% brighter) and is protected by a glass-ceramic material. The inner Super Actua Flex screen (also 3,600 nits) has narrower bezels, uses thicker ultra-thin glass, and features a dual-layer impact-resistant film for improved crease performance.

The new 48-megapixel wide-angle lens has 56% more light intake, and the telephoto lens supports 30x Super Zoom. The Pixel 11 Pro Fold also features HiLight.

The Tensor G6 processor comes with 16GB of RAM and 256GB of storage. The battery capacity has decreased from 5,015mAh to 4,750mAh, but it still maintains a 24+ hour battery life rating and supports 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging.

Gboard's instant transcription feature now supports American Sign Language. The sign language to text function allows you to "sign to the front-facing camera while the audience sees the transcribed text on the outer screen". Combined with Android 17's Bubble Bar (displayed in the bottom right corner), as well as two new Made You Look animations in the camera app.

The Pixel 11 Pro Fold has a US$100 price increase to US$1,899, but comes with 16GB of RAM and 256GB of storage.

Tensor G6

The new Gemini Nano 4 model is equipped with a TPU, with 50% increased computing power and doubled memory bandwidth. This enables on-device AI tasks to be up to 3.5 times faster while reducing power consumption by up to 3.5 times.

Additionally, the CPU portion delivers 15% faster app loading and 25% faster web browsing.

The upgraded ISP (Image Signal Processor) unlocks camera features such as a wider zoom range and better low-light performance. A new custom accelerator is designed specifically for shooting and rendering portrait videos, supporting 4K bokeh video.

Equipped with the new Titan M3 security chip, enhancing protection against future quantum computing threats.

New Pixel Camera and Video Features

Although the camera app interface remains largely unchanged, Google has made several adjustments to accommodate new features. For example, quick controls now include Looks, focus, shutter speed, and ISO sliders in addition to the original white balance, exposure, and shadows. The new interface allows you to customize functions on both sides of the viewfinder after tapping.

  • Pixel 11 camera features new main sensor, "Camera Looks", "Instant Night Sight" and more
  • Pixel 11's video recording capabilities are comprehensively enhanced, bringing features such as Pro Stable Video and Creator Suite

Magic Capture is quite similar to Google Clips—you just start a shooting phase, and Google automatically picks the best HDR+ photos and videos. Accessed from a new tab next to the viewfinder, the system analyzes about 500 frames to find the best image, and offers simple editing features such as cropping, straightening, and fixing blur. The goal is to let you focus on the moment and enjoy the process.

Camera Looks lets you set preset aesthetic styles when shooting. Google has made adjustments to the camera image processing pipeline, such as "merging fewer frames than usual for a minimally processed look" and "rewriting the color lookup table at the sensor level to simulate traditional film chemistry". The Pixel 11 offers the following HDR alternatives:

  • Natural: Soft details
  • Shadows: Deeper contrast
  • Vanilla: Softer, warmer golden tones

There are also Stylistic Looks, including Digi, Black Tie, Minimal, Editorial, Classic and Velvet, which users can further edit.

On-device video processing has been improved in terms of sharpening, noise reduction, and detail, while the Pixel 11 Pro's Pro Stable Video will activate in well-lit but shaky scenes. The new Creator Suite adds several tools to the camera app:

  • Teleprompter: Scrolls at your speaking speed and pauses, automatically matching your speech pace.
  • Project Folders: Store video clips in designated locations.
  • Audio Visualizer: Perform audio monitoring within the camera viewfinder.
  • Storyboard: Clip editing and rearrangement powered by Google Photos.
  • Social media grid

Gemini Intelligence

The Pixel 11 series' task automation feature has been expanded to more apps, helping you handle orders and reservations. Gemini can also call merchants to complete tasks.

Gboard Rambler goes beyond standard voice-to-text, filtering out messy sentences and filler words like "um" and "ah". When enabled, Rambler replaces Gboard's suggestion bar with a new waveform animation. It captures your meaning and outputs clean, concise voice-to-text transcripts.

Proactive Assistance (formerly Magic Cue) provides contextual suggestions across a wider range of apps with a richer interface. Tapping these suggestions brings up a bottom sheet. You can view detailed flight information with live status links, Google Maps business profiles, calendar previews when scheduling (such as restaurant reservations), and comparison results. Gemini Intelligence can also suggest saving events to your calendar and other information to Google Wallet.

Google previewed a new At a Glance feature that can detect your location, showing membership cards when you're at a store, and Google Maps business profiles when at a restaurant.

Live Translate, which was added to calls last year, is now expanded through the Tensor G6 to podcasts and videos within YouTube and other supported apps, providing real-time audio dubbing.

New Pixelsnap Accessories

The latest Pixelsnap cases come in colors matching the phone, with a new transparent case added this year. The Pixelsnap Ring Stand is available in three colors: Canyon, Olive, and Obsidian.

Hands-on｜Pre-order: Google Store — Amazon

Pixel Tag

The Google Pixel Tag is a Find Hub tracker priced at US$29 (US$99 for a four-pack). It features a pill-shaped design with a "G" logo and uses a replaceable button battery on the back. This accessory will not go on sale until November 11.

Pixel Buds Pro 2 Update

The Pixel Buds Pro 2 adds an Olive color option. More importantly, the Pixel Buds Pro 2 and Pixel Buds 2a will receive a major software update in September. The new Pro 2 firmware will adjust noise cancellation based on how the earbuds are worn. Google says "when there are slight changes in seal, the system automatically adjusts to compensate".

Additionally, the Pixel Buds Pro 2 and Pixel Buds 2a will receive Gemini voice control, allowing you to adjust settings via voice commands such as "Hey Google, turn up the bass".

The Pixel Watch's Sleep Sync feature will automatically pause music, disable touch controls, and mute notifications when it detects you've fallen asleep. The upgraded Live Translate can activate "listening mode" with one tap, providing nearly instant translation in over 70 languages.

Pixel Watch 5

The Pixel Watch 5 looks the same as the previous generation. Internally, it's upgraded to the Snapdragon W5 Gen 2 Accelerated processor, with 12% improved CPU performance, and RAM increased from 2GB to 3GB. Combined with the M55 co-processor, overall device speed is improved by 20%. Storage has also doubled to 64GB.

The Pixel Watch 5's route tracking and map accuracy have doubled in urban environments, hiking trails, and other complex settings. Google says its performance surpasses the Apple Watch Ultra 3 and Garmin Fenix 8 Pro.

  • The Pixel Watch 5 may not look much different on the surface, but you'll notice the difference when using the At a Glance feature [Hands-on]
  • The Pixel Watch 5 launches a "Stephen Curry Edition" with exclusive straps and watch faces [Photo gallery]
  • Pixel Watch 5 features a "second-generation Active Band"—here's what's new and why it matters

This year's health feature upgrades include enhanced strength training and HIIT experiences, new Bedtime Automations, new respiratory emergency detection, and blood pressure and insulin resistance trend tracking support.

Top comment posted by DiamondMaster115

I think the biggest surprise this time is that both the small-screen Pixel 11 Pro and the base Pixel 11 support Qi2.2 25W wireless charging? Anyone else feel the same way?

Two new watch faces are added this year—Weave and Chronograph—as well as new complication function styles. You can also use generative AI watch faces, quite similar to the AI wallpapers on your phone.

Gemini Intelligence brings the At a Glance feature to the bottom of the watch face, displaying flight information, boarding passes, and transit stations. Proactive Suggestions can appear as one-tap actions in apps like Google Messages. Offline Gemini command support lets you control timers, alarms, and even start workouts.

The Pixel Watch 5 starts at US$399 (41mm, plus US$50) and US$429 (45mm, plus US$30), with the LTE version costing an additional US$100.
